name: Cyber-AutoAgent
description: Python agent on the Strands SDK that runs a penetration test from a Kali container without approval steps, with a bundled Langfuse stack
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: Blind XSS callback Cyber-AutoAgent's general module passes to dalfox (-b https://dalfox-xss-test.com) for up to 10 parameters of a target. In requests to your sites it means the tool was pointed at you; a lookup from your network means a stored payload ran. Other dalfox users could choose the same name
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Cyber-AutoAgent source code
